mapper.select:
SELECT FROM `notification` n
WHERE n.active_dedup_key = #{dedupKey} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT FROM `notification` n
WHERE n.user_id = #{userId} AND n.notice_type = 1 AND n.status = 1 AND COALESCE(n.ref_type, 'system_announcement') = 'system_announcement' ORDER BY n.send_time DESC, n.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO `notification` (user_id, title, content, notice_type, ref_type, ref_id, level, is_read, send_time, publisher_id, publisher_name, status, remark) SELECT #{userId}, source.title, source.content, 1, 'system_announcement', grouped.announcement_id, source.level, 0, source.send_time, source.publisher_id, source.publisher_name, 1, source.remark FROM ( SELECT COALESCE(n.ref_id, n.id) AS announcement_id, MIN(n.id) AS source_id FROM `notification` n WHERE n.status = 1 AND n.notice_type = 1 AND COALESCE(n.ref_type, 'system_announcement') = 'system_announcement' GROUP BY COALESCE(n.ref_id, n.id) ) grouped INNER JOIN `notification` source ON source.id = grouped.source_id LEFT JOIN `notification` existing ON existing.user_id = #{userId} AND existing.notice_type = 1 AND existing.status = 1 AND COALESCE(existing.ref_type, 'system_announcement') = 'system_announcement' AND COALESCE(existing.ref_id, existing.id) = grouped.announcement_id WHERE existing.id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM `notification` n WHERE n.user_id = #{userId} AND n.notice_type = 1 AND n.status = 1 AND n.is_read = 0 AND COALESCE(n.ref_type, 'system_announcement') = 'system_announcement'
mapper.update: UPDATE `notification` n SET n.is_read = 1, n.read_time = #{readTime} WHERE n.user_id = #{userId} AND n.notice_type = 1 AND n.status = 1 AND n.is_read = 0 AND COALESCE(n.ref_type, 'system_announcement') = 'system_announcement'
mapper.select:
SELECT MIN(n.id) AS id, NULL AS user_id, NULL AS username, NULL AS nickname, MAX(n.title) AS title, MAX(n.content) AS content, 1 AS notice_type, 'system_announcement' AS ref_type, COALESCE(n.ref_id, n.id) AS ref_id, NULL AS task_id, NULL AS task_title, NULL AS task_type, NULL AS task_status, NULL AS plot_name, NULL AS alert_id, NULL AS alert_title, NULL AS alert_level, MAX(n.level) AS level, NULL AS is_read, NULL AS read_time, MAX(n.send_time) AS send_time, MAX(n.publisher_id) AS publisher_id, MAX(n.publisher_name) AS publisher_name, COUNT(1) AS recipient_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN n.is_read = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS read_count, 1 AS status, MAX(n.remark) AS remark, MIN(n.create_time) AS create_time, MAX(n.update_time) AS update_time FROM `notification` n
n.status = 1 AND n.notice_type = 1 AND COALESCE(n.ref_type, 'system_announcement') = 'system_announcement'
AND n.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{title}, '%')
AND n.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{content}, '%')
AND n.send_time >= #{startTime}
AND n.send_time <= #{endTime}
GROUP BY COALESCE(n.ref_id, n.id) ORDER BY MAX(n.send_time) DESC, MIN(n.id) DESC

SELECT grouped.* FROM ( SELECT MIN(n.id) AS id, NULL AS user_id, NULL AS username, NULL AS nickname, MAX(n.title) AS title, MAX(n.content) AS content, 1 AS notice_type, 'system_announcement' AS ref_type, COALESCE(n.ref_id, n.id) AS ref_id, NULL AS task_id, NULL AS task_title, NULL AS task_type, NULL AS task_status, NULL AS plot_name, NULL AS alert_id, NULL AS alert_title, NULL AS alert_level, MAX(n.level) AS level, NULL AS is_read, NULL AS read_time, MAX(n.send_time) AS send_time, MAX(n.publisher_id) AS publisher_id, MAX(n.publisher_name) AS publisher_name, COUNT(1) AS recipient_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN n.is_read = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS read_count, 1 AS status, MAX(n.remark) AS remark, MIN(n.create_time) AS create_time, MAX(n.update_time) AS update_time FROM `notification` n WHERE n.status = 1 AND n.notice_type = 1 AND COALESCE(n.ref_type, 'system_announcement') = 'system_announcement' GROUP BY COALESCE(n.ref_id, n.id) ) grouped WHERE grouped.id = #{id} OR grouped.ref_id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(1) AS totalCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN grouped.level = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS urgentCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN grouped.send_time >= CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS todayCount, COALESCE(SUM(grouped.recipient_count - grouped.read_count), 0) AS unreadDeliveryCount FROM ( SELECT COALESCE(n.ref_id, n.id) AS announcement_id, MAX(n.level) AS level, MAX(n.send_time) AS send_time, COUNT(1) AS recipient_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN n.is_read = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS read_count FROM `notification` n WHERE n.status = 1 AND n.notice_type = 1 AND COALESCE(n.ref_type, 'system_announcement') = 'system_announcement' GROUP BY COALESCE(n.ref_id, n.id) ) grouped

SELECT grouped.* FROM ( SELECT MIN(n.id) AS id, NULL AS user_id, NULL AS username, NULL AS nickname, MAX(n.title) AS title, MAX(n.content) AS content, 2 AS notice_type, MAX(n.ref_type) AS ref_type, COALESCE(n.ref_id, n.id) AS ref_id, MAX(COALESCE(n.task_id, CASE WHEN n.ref_type = 'farm_task' THEN n.ref_id ELSE NULL END)) AS task_id, MAX(ft.task_title) AS task_title, MAX(ft.task_type) AS task_type, MAX(ft.status) AS task_status, MAX(p.plot_name) AS plot_name, MAX(n.alert_id) AS alert_id, NULL AS alert_title, NULL AS alert_level, MAX(n.level) AS level, NULL AS is_read, NULL AS read_time, MAX(n.send_time) AS send_time, MAX(n.publisher_id) AS publisher_id, MAX(n.publisher_name) AS publisher_name, COUNT(1) AS recipient_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN n.is_read = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS read_count, 1 AS status, MAX(n.remark) AS remark, MIN(n.create_time) AS create_time, MAX(n.update_time) AS update_time FROM `notification` n LEFT JOIN `farm_task` ft ON ft.id = COALESCE(n.task_id, CASE WHEN n.ref_type = 'farm_task' THEN n.ref_id ELSE NULL END) LEFT JOIN `plot` p ON p.id = ft.plot_id WHERE n.status = 1 AND n.notice_type = 2 AND COALESCE(n.ref_type, 'farm_task_message') IN ('farm_task_message', 'farm_task') GROUP BY COALESCE(n.ref_id, n.id) ) grouped WHERE grouped.id = #{id} OR grouped.ref_id = #{id} LIMIT 1

UPDATE `notification` SET task_id = #{taskId}, title = #{title}, content = #{content}, level = #{level}, remark = CASE WHEN remark = '农事任务产生后自动生成' THEN '用户已编辑：原自动农事消息' ELSE remark END WHERE status = 1 AND notice_type = 2 AND COALESCE(ref_type, 'farm_task_message') IN ('farm_task_message', 'farm_task') AND COALESCE(ref_id, id) = #{refId}
